environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster but namespace 'platform-services' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (PSA restricted profile). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing hostPath volumes. The OPA Gatekeeper constraint K8sPSPHostFilesystem is also active as a secondary admission controller with enforcementAction: deny. Note: the PSA restricted profile alone would block privileged containers but does NOT explicitly block hostPath in all API versions — the Kyverno policy covers that gap. Container image is scanned by Trivy admission webhook but this only checks CVEs not runtime behavior.
